_comment: NHS England cancer screening programme cohort eligibility criteria. Source of truth for system cohorts seeded at startup. Criteria sourced Feb 2026.

cohorts.name: NHS Bowel Cancer Screening — Eligible (50–74)
cohorts.description: Patients aged 50–74 eligible for NHS Bowel Cancer Screening Programme (FIT home kit every 2 years). Ages 75+ can self-refer but are not routinely invited.

cohorts.name: NHS Bowel Cancer Screening — Self-refer eligible (75+)
cohorts.description: Patients aged 75 and over who are eligible to self-refer into the NHS Bowel Cancer Screening Programme (not automatically invited).

cohorts.name: NHS Breast Screening — Eligible (female, 50–70)
cohorts.description: Female patients aged 50–70 eligible for NHS Breast Screening Programme (mammogram every 3 years; first invite between ages 50–53).

cohorts.name: NHS Breast Screening — Self-refer eligible (female, 71+)
cohorts.description: Female patients aged 71 and over who are eligible to self-refer into NHS Breast Screening (every 3 years; not automatically invited).

cohorts.name: NHS Cervical Screening — Eligible (female, 25–64)
cohorts.description: Female patients aged 25–64 eligible for NHS Cervical Screening Programme (HPV primary screening every 5 years).

cohorts.name: NHS Lung Cancer Screening — Eligible (55–74, ever smoker)
cohorts.description: Patients aged 55–74 who are current or former smokers, eligible for NHS Targeted Lung Health Check (lung health check + low-dose CT if high risk). Available in selected areas; roll-out ongoing across England.
